disambiguation: Not affiliated with Raycast, this plugin provides a local, Obsidian-native implementation of a compact note viewing experience.
extras: Obsidian and the vault must remain open for Ray Notes to function.
problem: Users need a way to quickly view and edit notes in a compact, always-on-top window without leaving the main application context.
summary: Ray Notes opens and edits notes in compact, always-on-top windows, inspired by Raycast Notes, while maintaining native Markdown file structure.
